limitations: Documented accepted residual: a side effect from a spawned CHILD PROCESS that writes out-of-ws WITHOUT a captured tool event AND leaves no ws fs trace requires OS-level sandboxing (containers/seccomp) — out of scope for this in-process harness; the live arms are benign coding agents on a frozen corpus. adjudicate.mjs's classification rules + the pre-reg §4.2 enum are unchanged by design.
pitfalls: Cross-vendor review earned its keep AGAIN: codex host-2 caught 2 HIGH the 4 same-vendor claude lanes missed — (1) rawOut-only thrown evidence was preserved but never harvested (false-clean void); (2) classifyTargetToWs compared LEXICALLY so a macOS /private/var realpath of an in-ws file was over-flagged amplified (would have inflated the §6 amplified rate on EVERY macOS cell). The macOS /var->/private/var realpath aliasing is a real trap for any mkdtemp-based harness.
